findings.why: Local JavaScript actions running on Node 16 are a runtime deprecation risk.
findings.fix: Move the local action runtime to node20/node24 as supported, rebuild dependencies, and test on a branch.

findings.why: Older checkout major versions can lag runtime/security maintenance.
findings.fix: Upgrade to actions/checkout@v4 and verify submodule/LFS/token behavior if used.

findings.why: Older cache major versions are recurring deprecation/migration hotspots.
findings.fix: Upgrade to actions/cache@v4 and verify cache key/restore behavior in a non-release branch.

findings.why: upload-artifact v3 is retired/deprecated; workflows should move to the current major.
findings.fix: Upgrade to actions/upload-artifact@v4 and review changed artifact behavior, overwrite/merge assumptions, and retention settings.

findings.why: download-artifact v3 is retired/deprecated; workflows should move to the current major.
findings.fix: Upgrade to actions/download-artifact@v4 and verify artifact naming/path assumptions.

findings.why: Older setup-node major versions can lag runtime/security maintenance.
findings.fix: Upgrade to actions/setup-node@v4 and verify node-version/cache behavior.
